name: Gemini — Multi-Image Consistent Session
summary: Creates a set of images with Gemini that share the same characters and style, saving each to your image library.
description: Manually trigger with an array of prompts; generates one image per prompt in a SINGLE continued Gemini chat session so characters/style/look stay consistent, saving each to the image vault (sequential img-NNN ids). Any number of prompts — the run length follows the array. Run with: workflow templates run gemimgmany --input '{"prompts":["a wizard in a blue robe casting a fire spell","the same wizard riding a red dragon"]}'. Requires `monoagentcli login gemini` once beforehand.
